input.quote: (a) At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding, either party may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon fifteen (15) days advance notice to the other.
input.rationale: Convenience termination is available only when no Statement of Work is outstanding, so we have no exit from live engagements, and Contractor may walk on just 15 days' notice. We added a 30-day Company convenience right (covering any Statement of Work) with a pro-rata refund and no penalty, and moved Contractor's convenience right to 90 days between engagements.

input.quote: 2. TERM. The term of this Agreement shall begin on the date hereof and shall continue until terminated by either party pursuant to Paragraph 6 hereof.
input.rationale: The term is evergreen-until-terminated with no automatic renewal term, no non-renewal notice window and no renewal price uplift mechanic, so there is nothing to shorten or cap under this rule (rate changes are handled as a pricing point in Section 3(b)).
